New Hampshire Primaries: Pappas and Sununu Win Key Senate Races

In New Hampshire's primary elections, Chris Pappas won the Democratic nomination for the U.S. Senate, while John Sununu secured the Republican nomination. Both candidates will now face off in the general election for the open Senate seat, which is considered a battleground race. The primaries also saw Kelly Ayotte win the Republican nomination for governor, and Cinde Warmington win the Democratic nomination for governor. These contests are part of a broader set of elections that will determine control of the U.S. Senate.
